description: This file defines the class KmsMaterialsProviderV2, which implements a materials provider for AWS KMS encryption, enabling encryption and decryption of data encryption keys using AWS KMS within the AWS SDK for PHP.

classes.name: KmsMaterialsProviderV2
classes.description: A provider class that utilizes AWS KMS for encryption key management, extending MaterialsProviderV2 and implementing MaterialsProviderInterfaceV2 for handling encryption materials using KMS.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the KMS client and optional key ID for key management.

methods.name: getWrapAlgorithmName
methods.description: Returns the name of the key wrapping algorithm used, 'kms+context'.

methods.name: decryptCek
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted CEK using AWS KMS, with optional specific key ID or fallback.

methods.name: generateCek
methods.description: Generates a data encryption key via KMS, requiring an encryption context and handling key specifications.
